card_set: Stage 1 source-inspired hypotheses for outcome-unseen Stage 2 battery conditions

cards.condition_region: 45 degrees Celsius and SOC_max=0.90 (Stage 2 group k|45|0.9)
cards.stage1_evidence: The frozen Stage 1 calendar source predicts 93.52 percent terminal RPT capacity retention for this Stage 2 region, the lowest of the eight Stage 2 calendar groups. Its Stage 1-scaled source distance is 0.105 and normalized source uncertainty is 0.769.
cards.expected_retention_direction: lower retention than the same-SOC, lower-temperature control k|23|0.9; also no better than the same-temperature, lower-SOC group k|45|0.65
cards.physical_rationale: High storage temperature accelerates parasitic reactions and high SOC raises electrode potentials; their conjunction should increase calendar capacity loss if the Stage 1 degradation pattern transfers locally.
matched_controls: k|23|0.9: same SOC_max with lower temperature; frozen source prediction 94.87 percent
k|45|0.65: same temperature with lower SOC_max; frozen source prediction 94.36 percent
cards.falsifier: The hypothesis is falsified if measured Stage 2 mean retention for k|45|0.9 is not lower than k|23|0.9, or if both charge-only and discharge-only sensitivities reverse the predicted ordering.
cards.planned_diagnostic_measurement: Primary 23-degree mean RPT capacity retention, with the prespecified charge-only and discharge-only retention sensitivities; no alternative endpoint may replace it.

cards.condition_region: 45 degrees Celsius, SOC_max=0.80, DOD=0.60, C_ch=1.0, C_dch=0.26 (Stage 2 group z|45|0.8|0.6|1|0.26)
cards.stage1_evidence: The frozen Stage 1 cycle source predicts 84.51 percent terminal RPT capacity retention, the lowest of the fifteen Stage 2 cycle groups. Its Stage 1-scaled source distance is 0.313 and normalized source uncertainty is 0.705.
cards.expected_retention_direction: lower retention than lower-window cycle regions and within the poor-retention family formed by the four 45-degree, SOC_max=0.80, DOD=0.60 Stage 2 groups
cards.physical_rationale: The conjunction of high temperature, high upper SOC, deep cycling, and a 1C charge exposes the cell to thermally accelerated side reactions and a broad cycling window. The low discharge rate does not negate the high-temperature/high-window burden and is itself a falsifiable qualifier.
matched_controls: z|45|0.41|0.05|1|1: same temperature and charge rate but a much smaller SOC window; frozen source prediction 91.30 percent
z|45|0.8|0.6|1|2: same temperature, SOC_max, DOD, and charge rate but higher discharge rate; frozen source prediction 85.87 percent
cards.falsifier: The broad high-temperature/high-window hypothesis is falsified if the selected group is not worse than z|45|0.41|0.05|1|1. The low-discharge-rate qualifier is falsified if the paired C_dch=2 group is clearly worse beyond group-level uncertainty.
cards.planned_diagnostic_measurement: Primary 23-degree mean RPT capacity retention and charge/discharge sensitivity, reported by complete condition group; later resistance analysis is secondary and cannot rescue this card.

claim_rule: These are source-inspired, prospectively frozen hypotheses inside a retrospective public dataset. They become validated scientific leads only if the still-sealed Stage 2 condition-group outcomes satisfy the named ordering and falsifier. A favorable result is not a prospective laboratory discovery.
nonreplacement_rule: Both cards and all named controls must be reported after Stage 2 release. A failed card cannot be replaced by a more favorable Stage 2 subgroup.
